text: Weekly Mood Tracker (1-10): Mood/Energy/Sleep. Decline >2 weeks = visit a specialist. Drawing creates awareness.

review_defects.why: In the context of a mood tracker, 'الرسم' refers to the act of charting or plotting data, not artistic drawing. 'Drawing' may be misinterpreted; 'Charting' or 'Plotting' would be more accurate.
